why: spec 006 §14 A4: no description, intro, `seoTitle` or `seoDescription` may state a lead time or a next-day claim. We hold no such data (`src/config/countries.ts` deliberately carries no `delivery_days`) and the cutoff sentence is spec 009's per-country block, so the claim would be unbacked on a page that cannot even compute it.

set.seoDescription: Birthday flowers hand-made by our florist in the recipient's city, with next day delivery across Europe.
